==Notes==
*There is a [[miniature]] [[Miniature Black Beast Of Arrgh|version]] of this [[NPC]].
*One of the [[Mysterious Tonic]]'s forms.
*One of the [[Mysterious Summoning Stone]]'s summons.
*Despite being a dervish, its unique drop is a shield.

==Trivia==
*This boss is a reference to a similarly named beast from [[w:Monty Python and the Holy Grail|Monty Python and the Holy Grail]]. However, the beast in the movie is green, despite being called the Black Beast, and appears reptilian rather than insectoid.
